en: Theragāthā 2.48 Dukanipāta, Pañcamavagga I am one who has reached the goal, I am one who has done what was to be done; having laid down the burden, I am freed from all fetters. My mind is well-liberated by means of the destruction of craving; I have attained final Nibbāna in this very life. I am one who has crossed over the flood, I am one who has gone beyond the mire. I am a monk who has attained peace, I am one who has reached the further shore.
